g.text: Requesting and reading an AI analysis (sequence, UC-05, UC-06)
model router: each module with inputs,
then fusion; explanation or reason per module
Today every module is a labelled MOCK:
its numbers come from a hash of the job id,
never from the patient's values or images.
A trained model would read the de-identified
copies by the keys it is given.
status, and the report when ready
"DEVELOPMENT MOCK DATA — NOT A CLINICAL RESULT",
probability range, grade group, modules, explanations
